standard_prerequisites.name: Transitivity sequence
standard_prerequisites.use: The short exact sequence of conormals.

standard_prerequisites.name: Deformation lemmas
standard_prerequisites.use: Flatness, pullback compatibility, and finite-locally-free persistence of the lift.

core_obligations: Split the transitivity sequence over the affine Z and transport the splitting to the ideal I of the universal thickening Z'' of Z over X'.
Define Z' as the closed subscheme cut by the summand C_{Z/X} and verify the diagram of first-order thickenings.
Use flatness of X' over U' to identify C_{Z/Z'} with the pullback of C_{U/U'} and conclude flatness, pullback compatibility, and finite locally freeness of Z' -> U'.
proof_roadmap: Split the conormal sequence, cut out the thickening by the summand, and run the deformation lemmas to certify flatness and finite local freeness of the lift.
difficulty_reason: Deformation-theoretic construction: splitting, ideal bookkeeping, and three deformation lemmas chained.
